# UCAT Complete Guidance

> Strategy-first UCAT ANZ tutoring for students applying to medicine and dentistry in Australia and New Zealand. Founded and taught by Sarthak Mehta, a medical doctor (Flinders University MD) based in Adelaide, South Australia. Sessions run online, so students anywhere in Australia can join.

Key facts (as stated on ucatcompleteguidance.com):
- 230+ students prepared; 78% with medicine or dentistry offers.
- 2026 cohort highest score: 2,580 (top 50 in Australia).
- The founder sat the UCAT as a school leaver: 97th percentile, 99.95 ATAR, offers from 12+ Australian medical schools.
- Course: all 20 UCAT question types across Verbal Reasoning (VR), Decision Making (DM), Quantitative Reasoning (QR) and Situational Judgement (SJT); 2.5 hours of live teaching per week (1.5-hour strategy session + 1-hour evaluation session); 1 hour of guided homework per week; 4,000+ practice questions; three full-length timed mock exams; progress tests at Weeks 10 and 16; all lessons recorded; free evaluation sessions after the course; free interview (MMI and panel) workshop; free medicine/dentistry applications workshop.
- Approach: one locked-in strategy per question type, building accuracy first and then speed, personalised to each student's weak points.
- Free 30-minute diagnostic consultation for students and parents, and a free online UCAT diagnostic test.

Contact: enquiries@ucatcompleteguidance.com · +61 468 423 459 · https://ucatcompleteguidance.com/#tab-contact

## Free UCAT guides

- [UCAT Percentiles 2026: Where Does Your Score Rank?](https://ucatcompleteguidance.com/ucat-percentiles/): where every total score sits in the 2026 UCAT ANZ cohort and what it means for medical school applications.
- [What UCAT Score Will Get You Into Med School?](https://ucatcompleteguidance.com/ucat-score-requirements/): UCAT cutoffs, weighting models and selection processes at Australian medical schools, by state.
- [What Is the UCAT ANZ?](https://ucatcompleteguidance.com/what-is-the-ucat/): beginner's guide to the sections, scoring, 2026 exam patterns and how to prepare.
- [UCAT Verbal Reasoning Tips: Why Most Students Lose Marks](https://ucatcompleteguidance.com/verbal-reasoning-tips/): the repeatable VR traps behind most errors and the decision rules that fix them.
- [UCAT Score Calculator 2026](https://ucatcompleteguidance.com/ucat-calculator/): enter a total UCAT score to see its percentile and which medical schools are within reach, by state.

## Free tools

- [Free UCAT diagnostic test](https://ucatcompleteguidance.com/diagnostic-test/): short diagnostic across the UCAT subtests that shows which traps are costing marks.
